emptyBody: When a search or an application runs, you can watch what it does here as it happens: each step, the sites it reached and anything it was stopped from reaching.
emptyCheck: Run a check to see one at work.
unavailableTitle: Agents can’t run on this instance
unavailableBody: It has no sandbox to run them in, so no check can start here. Whoever runs this instance can set one up.

outcome.ended_max_steps: Stopped: it took too many steps
outcome.ended_budget: Stopped: it used up its token budget
outcome.ended_timeout: Stopped: it ran out of time
outcome.ended_loop: Stopped: it was going round in circles

failure.agent_exited: Its agent stopped before it finished.
failure.server_restarted: The server restarted while it ran.
failure.generic: Something went wrong while it ran.

noEvents.agent: Nothing yet. Its steps appear here as it takes them.
noEvents.sandbox: No requests yet. Each site it tries to reach appears here, allowed or blocked.

noEventsEnded.sandbox: It tried to reach no site.

errors.too_many_runs: Too many runs are waiting. Try again once one has ended.
errors.sandboxes_unavailable: Agents can’t run on this instance: it has no sandbox to run them in.
errors.unknown_kind: This instance can’t run that check.
errors.generic: The check couldn’t start. Try again.

stopFailed: It couldn’t be stopped. Try again.
